Each bar shows the number of recordings made while the participant was within that age group.

Age at reported year of diagnosis

MaleFemale

Each point is one participant, and the curve is a kernel density estimate of these ages.

Profession by diagnostic group

PDControl

13 categories, sorted by total. Overlapping dots indicate equal counts.

Race by participant pair

One square per participant, by sex and diagnostic group. Mirrored squares are PD–Control partners, who share race in 28 of 30 pairs.

Nationality by participant pair

One square per participant, by sex and diagnostic group. Mirrored squares are PD–Control partners, who share nationality in 16 of 30 pairs.

Recording coverage by participant pair

Each dot is one recording, placed by its year relative to baseline: −3 is three years before, +3 three years after. Baseline is the reported year of diagnosis for each PD patient and, for each Control, the year of diagnosis of their matched PD partner (Control row n with PD row n). Pairs 1–15 are male and 16–30 are female.
